en: A colored postcard featuring a cityscape with a prominent baroque church tower (Franziskanerkirche) with a clock, set among old European-style buildings. In the background, a fortified hill with greenery (Schlossberg) and a distinctive clock tower can be seen. There is also a bridge crossing a river in the foreground. The top of the postcard reads: 'Graz. Franziskanerkirche und Schlossberg.'
